items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: And so he had a swinging band. I remember recording... and then Jug would come in behind him.

ctx.x: Yes. And so he had a swinging band. I remember recording. I've got it here now, 78, and the name of the tune was 'I Love the Rhythm of a Riff.' And 'I love the rhythm of a riff, ta-tee-ta-ta-tee-ta-ta-tee-ta,' and, man, he was swinging, and then Jug would come in behind him. That's all she wrote, you know. It was a great band he had. Oh, yes.
